title: Check system architecture and kernel info with uname
summary: Use the `uname` command to see details about your Mac's hardware architecture, processor, and kernel version. This is useful for troubleshooting or verifying compatibility.

steps.explain: Print the system architecture and processor information.
steps.expect: Output showing architecture (e.g., arm64) and processor type.

steps.explain: Print the kernel name, release, and version.
steps.expect: Output showing kernel name (Darwin), release, and version details.

steps.explain: Print all available system information at once.
steps.expect: A single line containing all system details including hostname, kernel, and architecture.
